_comment: The kit's shared material base (parts factory, workflow v0.1 step 3, pilot 1 KF-PORTAL-01, 6. 10. 2026). The quality principles of the SC etalon (Docs/Kit/etalon/etalon.md): a light lacquer, a polished lip 15-20 mm that draws the outline in reflections, a dark rubber / graphite; plus the floor's anti-slip graphite. Colours and wear come from the ship's maker (a palette here), so another maker supplies only another palette. Unreal: master /Game/Kit/Materials/M_Kit_Base (the layered master's graph, kit-only: hand-height band for edge wear, the walked line), instances MI_Kit_<Maker>_<Role> (Tools/Assets/import_kit.py build_factory_materials). Blender preview: Tools/Kit/kit_geo.py materials(). Limits checked by Tools/Tests/test_kit_materials.py.

limits._comment: FACTORY_WORKFLOW v0.1 step 3 and the etalon: [min, max]. Lacquer metallic <= 0.1 and structure-type surfaces <= 0.5 (catalog_draft lesson P10: metal without reflections went black).

roles._comment: Per role: which palette colour, roughness, metallic and the wear switches of the maker's style. 'bevel_mm' = the bevel the parts give this role's edges: the edge wear is as wide as the bevel (kit_geo Col.G = 0 on bevel faces).

Halcyon._comment: Halcyon Freightworks (part.md KF-PORTAL-01 step 1b, author 6. 10. 2026: the frame all cream lacquer). edge_wear 1.0 / threshold 0.15: at 0.8 / 0.35 the 4 mm worn bevels did not show on the board (round 2). Wear: a maintained working ship - dirt in the seams, edge wear 2-6 mm only at hand and shoulder height, the walked line; no overall wear.

Kestrel._comment: Kestrel Dynamics (kit-design.md proposal, not approved): a light grey-white lacquer, dark gunmetal, a blue accent; cleaner than Halcyon.
